description:
Site logo + wordmark, linking back to the homepage.
Pure presentation — all strings and the logo image come from `data`.

props.name: data
props.description: Brand strings and logo image, fully i18n-ready

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names merged onto the root anchor

description:
The primary interactive control for triggering actions.
Use `variant="danger"` for destructive actions like delete.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label / content

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to fill its container width

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon element rendered before the label

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner and disables interaction

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the button

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button

props.name: children

props.name: interactive

props.name: padding
props.description: Internal padding in pixels

description: Header region for a Card, rendering a title and optional subtitle.

props.name: title
props.description: Main heading text

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional supporting text below the title

description:
Sticky site header with brand, primary navigation, theme toggle and a
collapsible mobile menu. Owns only its own open/closed UI state — all
copy and links are supplied by the caller.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand strings and logo, forwarded to <Brand />

props.name: closeMenuLabel
props.description: aria-label for the mobile menu button when the menu is open

props.name: openMenuLabel
props.description: aria-label for the mobile menu button when the menu is closed

props.name: primaryNav
props.description: Primary navigation links, shown inline on desktop and in the mobile sheet

props.name: themeGroupLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the theme toggle radiogroup

props.name: themeLabel
props.description: Label shown next to the theme toggle in the mobile menu

props.name: themeOptions
props.description: Theme toggle options, forwarded to <ThemeToggle />

props.name: testNumber
props.description: aria-label for the mobile menu button when the menu is open

description: A labeled text input with built-in error and helper text states.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; when set, the input is styled as invalid

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the input when there is no error

props.name: label
props.description: Label displayed above the input

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the input
